decisions.reason: The same message already has a target-specific MODIFY for recreating the rendered buttons; the color-reference change does not necessarily alter the existing silver control color or require another update.

The bottom-logo clause is already represented by a same-message MODIFY, while the candidate's existing font-color requirement already points to the supplied reference and is not necessarily changed by the source color update.
The same message already introduces the Deck 1 and Deck 2 labels and their rendering reference; the separate color-reference change adds no necessary label-state change.
The same message already introduces the back-panel design and font references, and the source color update does not necessarily modify either attribute.
The power-button lighting clause is already represented by a same-message introduction; no lighting color or other additional change is entailed by the source color-reference update.
The source refers to lighting around the power button, not the independently specified LED lighting around the bowls, so the bowl-lighting state remains unchanged.
The source does not change the machine placard text, placement, duplication, or viewing orientations; general machine colors are owned by the source requirement.
Recreating the rendered buttons does not necessarily remove or change the independently specified cursive K markings or their beige color, and propagation would require an additional client decision.
The source does not mention the measurement-style markings around the bowls, and recreating general colors does not necessarily change their style, placement, or purpose.
The source changes aesthetic color references only and does not alter the support platform's configuration, clearance, height, cup size, or footprint.
The source does not mention spout geometry, orientation, material, mounting, or pour direction, so the spout requirement remains valid unchanged.
The aesthetic color-reference decision does not necessarily change the BOM deliverable or any recorded component selection or compatibility requirement.
